name: three-presenter
description: Framework-agnostic 3D viewer library built on Three.js

scripts.build:demo: npm run build && mkdir -p docs/dist && cp -r dist/* docs/dist/
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run docs && mkdir -p docs/dist && cp -r dist/* docs/dist/
scripts.// build: Production build: bundle library + TypeScript declarations
scripts.// build:demo: Build library + copy artifacts to docs/dist/ (for local preview)
scripts.// build:all: Build library + generate API docs + copy to docs/dist/
scripts.// dev: Fast dev with Vite HMR (http://localhost:5173/docs) — recommended for quick iteration
scripts.// dev:docs: Watch src/ + rebuild + copy to docs/dist/ (use with 'serve' in another terminal)
scripts.// dev:live: Watch + rebuild + http-server at :3000 — one-command workflow with built files
scripts.// serve: Serve docs folder at http://localhost:3000 (use after build:demo or with dev:docs)
scripts.// docs: Generate TypeDoc API documentation into docs/api/
